rules.title: Real estate brokers and salesmen; persons finding dwelling accommodations for fee
rules.requirement: Only licensed brokers or salespersons may find dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee. Under the version effective August 1, 2025, a broker contracts solely with either the tenant or the landlord, and any fee may only be paid by the party who originally engaged the broker.
rules.key_value: Broker fee payable only by the party (landlord or tenant) who engaged the broker
rules.status_basis: Text as amended by 2025, 9, Sec. 43 effective August 1, 2025

requires.name: broker_bound_party
requires.text: Applies to brokers and salespersons finding dwelling accommodations for a fee

coverage.summary: Applies to licensed brokers and salespersons who find rental housing for a fee.

rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
